purpose: Variant-neutral semantic observations for a blinded adapter; names and transport encoding are not normative.

workspace_fixture.semantic_shape: Two independent records with numeric base and multiplier fields and a formula-derived product field; all identity/key choices are adapter-local.

target_assertions: Execute the same normalized sequence through a native process and a real wasm32 module behind the TypeScript Worker boundary.
Compare every normalized semantic observation to this fixed oracle and across targets.
Do not treat candidate message names, ABI layout, serialization bytes, generated IDs, or human diff text as normative.
The adapter may translate names and types only; it may not implement revision checks, semantic commands, calculations, snapshots, or state ownership.
